positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Frontend Engineer on the User Growth team

• Helped build out, launch, and maintain the TikTok on TV app (react, typescript)

• Added event logging and dashboards to track user behavior & performance metrics

• Conducted data analysis highlighting strong correlation between technical and business metrics,
making a compelling case for increased investment in performance optimizations

• Launched over a dozen successful A/B experiments, enhancing both UX & technical design

• Streamlined remote control navigation implementation; removed thousands of lines of code and
greatly increased developer efficiency, allowing for quicker feature roll-out

• Mentor new joiners and interns

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineer on the Location team

• Increased Guidebook* creation by 11% by implementing a redesign of the creation flow. Project included building with React and Typescript 

• Increased Experiences wish-listed by 19% by implementing new map card design & functionality

• Worked on GraphQL migration for Guidebooks project

*Guidebooks are a tool hosts use to share their favorite things to do and places to see in their neighborhood

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Intern on the Restaurants product

• Worked alongside our team's product manager, designer, and content strategist to implement new features

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Intern on Magical Trips Infrastructure team

•Designed and implemented admin tool to help organize markets

•Did early work for the Experiences map that helps user pin point things to do in the areas they search in

positions.title: Engineering Practicum Intern
positions.description:
•Worked on the backend team for Google Classroom, a Learning Management System used by millions of users all over the world

•Designed and implemented a full-stack feature, together with another engineer from the Web front-end team, that helps users to organize their data

•Defined the required API changes for the new functionality 

•Owned the design and the implementation of the Backend changes (Java), covering all the server stack, from low-level changes in the persistence layer to defining new server endpoints and updating existing ones

•Used both internal and open technologies. Open technologies include: Guava (Subset of Google Java Core Libraries), Protocol Buffers for Client/Server Communication, Guice for dependency injection, JUnit and Mockito for testing.

positions.title: Computer Science Summer Institute Student
positions.description:
•Intensive, interactive, and hands-on three week summer program with the goal of inspiring the tech leaders and innovators of tomorrow by supporting the study of computer science, software engineering and other closely related subjects

•Learned programming fundamentals directly from Google engineers, and designed and developed my very own application with two other participants to showcase to "Googlers" in the NY office

•Final Project: “All! The Courses”, website that aggregates educational material from several online learning platforms. Implemented Coursera, Khan Academy, iTunes U, and Google Users API, allowing users to search courses and sign in with their Gmails to view and save their favorites

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•Intern in the Hardware department, shadowing various electrical engineers 
•Involved in testing circuit boards and putting together my own
•Worked closely with the IT department

positions.title: Physics Consultant
positions.description: •Revising and improving the Physics and general science curricula (presentations, problem sets, and labs) used by my school and schools statewide
